evidence.excerpt: Yosemite National Park today announced it will no longer use a timed reservation system in 2026.

exception_note: Other permits and operational restrictions are separate.
rights_basis: NPS government-authored text excerpt and original planning summary; no media or marks reproduced
summary: NPS states that Yosemite is not using a timed entrance reservation system in 2026. This does not settle activity permits, camping, fees or road access.

evidence.excerpt: Timed Entry reservations are needed to enter Rocky Mountain National Park between the hours of 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily beginning on Friday, May 22 through Monday, October 12, 2026.

exception_note: Some camping/service reservations and wilderness permits have separate entry provisions. Re-entry also needs separate review; consult the official questions and answers.

summary: For areas outside Bear Lake Road, the reviewed 2026 window is May 22 through October 12, from 09:00 to 14:00 in park-local time.

evidence.excerpt: Timed Entry+ Bear Lake Road Reservations are needed to enter the Bear Lake Road Corridor between the hours of 5 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily beginning on Friday, May 22 through Sunday, October 18, 2026.
